stories.title: Sam Burns Wins FedEx St. Jude — Scheffler Falters with Fill-in Caddie

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
Sam Burns wins the FedEx St. Jude Championship.

Scheffler entered Sunday with a 2-shot lead — but his regular caddie left for a family emergency. A PGA Tour chaplain flew in at 2am to loop for him.

Scheffler T-3. Burns wins. #PGATour

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
Scottie Scheffler's caddie Ted Scott left Saturday night for a family emergency.

Brad Payne — the PGA Tour's chaplain — flew in at 2am and caddied for him in the final round of a $20M tournament.

Scheffler finished T-3. #PGATour

article.headline: Sam Burns Wins the FedEx St. Jude Championship as Scheffler's Caddie Drama Unfolds

stories.title: Akie Iwai Wins LPGA Portland Classic — Twin Sister Chisato Sprays Her with Champagne

x_posts.label: Post 2
x_posts.text:
Akie Iwai wins the LPGA Portland Classic by 4 shots.

Her twin sister Chisato finished T-3 — and then sprayed her with champagne on the 18th green.

Both Iwai twins have now won on the LPGA Tour in their rookie season. #LPGA

article.headline: Akie Iwai Wins the LPGA Portland Classic — Twin Sister Chisato Sprays Her with Champagne

stories.title: Jordan Spieth Lives to Fight Another Day

x_posts.label: Post 3
x_posts.text:
Jordan Spieth is going to the BMW Championship.

He opened with a bogey-free 65 at St. Jude. Advanced from No. 54 in FedExCup standings to inside the top 50.

It's his 15th consecutive FedEx Playoffs year. No top-10 all season. Still alive. #PGATour

article.headline: Jordan Spieth Secures His 15th Consecutive FedEx Playoffs Berth at the BMW Championship

stories.title: Rory McIlroy's Brutal St. Jude Week Ends

x_posts.label: Post 4
x_posts.text:
Rory McIlroy opened with a 74 (+4) at the FedEx St. Jude.

He was No. 12 in the FedExCup entering the week — so he almost certainly advances to BMW.

But the form heading into Bellerive is deeply concerning. #PGATour

article.headline: Rory McIlroy's Brutal Week at the FedEx St. Jude Championship Is Over — BMW Still Waits

stories.title: Three Events Next Week — BMW, LIV Indianapolis, CPKC Women's Open

x_posts.label: Post 5
x_posts.text:
Three golf events next week. Same window (Aug 20–23).

BMW Championship — Bellerive CC, St. Louis. First return since 2018. Top 50 only.
LIV Golf Indianapolis — Chatham Hills, Westfield, Indiana.
CPKC Women's Open — Edmonton. $2.75M purse.

Big week ahead. #Golf

article.headline: Three Major Golf Events Next Week: BMW Championship, LIV Indianapolis, and the CPKC Women's Open
